theme_strategy: Light Theme Priority (Vibrant Play Archetype). The design emphasizes trust (real money gaming) combined with accessibility and excitement.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Mobile-First Web Application. Wrap all main routes in a max-width container (`max-w-md mx-auto`) so it looks like a mobile app even on desktop screens.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns over content. Use solid colors or heavy backdrop-blur (glassmorphism) with high opacity.
Use `lucide-react` for all icons (Home, Wallet, Profile, Menu, Info, Bell, etc.).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., `data-testid="play-ludo-button"`).
Include subtle animations: hover states (`hover:-translate-y-0.5`), active/click states (`active:scale-95`), and smooth page transitions.
Implement Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove the default 'Vercel' look. Make them rounded, friendly, and vibrant.

For the Ludo board game card on the Home page, use the provided `ludo_board` image URL, overlay a dark gradient (`bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent`) at the bottom, and place the 'Play' button over it.
The Bottom Navigation should be fixed at the bottom (`fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md`), pushing content up via padding-bottom on the main layout.
Use the exact colors specified (Blue primary, Green wallet, Orange refer/profile, Purple notifications).
Do not use generic font families like Inter for headings. Use Outfit or Manrope (Google Fonts). Import them in the index.html or global css.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Apply transitions to specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Always use proper SVG icons (lucide-react).
Do not text-align center the entire app. Keep text left-aligned by default for readability.
Ensure all contrast ratios pass WCAG AA standards. If text is over an image, add a gradient overlay or text-shadow.
Use large clickable areas (min 44x44px) for mobile usability.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on the primary blue and green buttons is pure white. Use darker shades of text for light backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all icon buttons, bottom nav items, and interactive pills.
